findings.reason: Digitized group means, marker identifiers, sampling times, dose, route and extraction calibration are available. F0003:S3:T9:A100 states that no SD or individual IDs were recovered; A104 and A105 leave sampling/count relationships unresolved. Serial versus destructive sampling, actual versus nominal sampling status, assay limits, missingness definitions and animal-level dose histories are not established. Marker labels are not animal IDs. SOURCE_REVIEW is present but its formal definition is not supplied.
findings.needed_material: Confirm sampling design, group membership, applicable counts and variability definitions, timing status, assay/censoring metadata and record-status meaning. Retain digitized plotted times and group-summary status; defer model-dependent sufficiency to animal PK.
